## Use Input in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Input for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Input', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

## About the Input coding font

A highly customizable programming font (free for personal use). Input is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Input is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Input FAQ

### Is Input free?

Yes. Input is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Input support ligatures?

Yes. Input ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Input?

Input is available from Official Website and Font Preview. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
